segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: אֵין מוֹלִיכִין אֶת הַסּוּלָּם מִשּׁוֹבָךְ לְשׁוֹבָךְ, אֲבָל מַטֵּהוּ מֵחַלּוֹן לְחַלּוֹן. וּבֵית הִלֵּל מַתִּירִין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Beit Shammai say: One may not carry a ladder,» which was used for reaching doves, «from one dovecote to another. However,» one may move it slightly so that «he tilts it from one window to another» in the same dovecote. «And Beit Hillel permit» even carrying a ladder from one dovecote to another.

moves.summary: Beit Shammai forbid carrying the ladder between dovecotes.
